name: Meeting Status
definition: Status of the instructions related to a meeting.

MeetingResolutionStatus.name: Meeting Resolution Status
MeetingResolutionStatus.definition: Indicates whether the resolution is active or withdrawn.

InstructionCancellationStatus.name: Instruction Cancellation Status
InstructionCancellationStatus.definition: Status of the request for cancellation of an instruction.

NotificationStatus.name: Notification Status
NotificationStatus.definition: Specifies the status of the related notification.

Reason.name: Reason

Meeting.name: Meeting
